description: Figure 4 presents a bar chart illustrating the proportion of incorrectly and correctly answered samples based on Pop_GT, Pop_Ge, and Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge). The horizontal axis displays the categories “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Proportion,” employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20.  For each category, there are three bars representing different data series: “Pop_GT” (blue), “Pop_Ge” (orange), and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” (yellow). Within each category, the bars are arranged in the order of “Pop_GT,” “Pop_Ge,” and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge).”  For “Movies,” “Pop_GT” reaches approximately 180, “Pop_Ge” reaches approximately 140, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” reaches approximately 160. For “Songs,” “Pop_GT” reaches approximately 120, “Pop_Ge” reaches approximately 80, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” reaches approximately 100. For “Basketball,” “Pop_GT” reaches approximately 100, “Pop_Ge” reaches approximately 60, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” reaches approximately 80. The bars are not visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
